texts:
Week 7 left full-time starters with ugly box scores and gave touchdowns to backups who got the work because someone sat. Every buy and sell for Week 8, each with a price.

Best buy: Kenneth Walker III.
Best sell: Tony Pollard.
Let's get to it.
#ChiefsKingdom #TitanUp

Kenneth Walker III, KC RB: 74 percent of the snaps at SEA and 14 carries for 36. Kansas City ran no plays in the red zone. A week earlier, same role, 128 yards and 2 TDs.
RB4 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer an RB2 and a WR3.
#ChiefsKingdom

Matthew Golden, GB WR: 25 targets over the last two weeks, 12 at DET with 165 air yards, and only 39 yards. He sat out Monday's walkthrough (shoulder, foot) before Thursday vs CAR.
WR25 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR3.
#GoPackGo

Derrick Henry, BAL RB: 17 carries in each of the last two games and 103 yards with Tyler Huntley throwing. Lamar Jackson is expected in a decent spot for Week 8 at BUF.
RB8 rest of season for me. Trade for him before Lamar is back; offer a WR2.
#RavensFlock

Chris Olave, NO WR: 23 targets over the last three games, 26 percent of the throws vs PIT, and only 145 yards. The Saints are on bye, so his manager eats a zero this week.
WR7 rest of season for me. Trade for him during the bye; offer a WR2.
#Saints

Justin Jefferson, MIN WR: 29 percent of the targets vs IND and 4 catches for 44, with Kyler Murray at 150 yards and still learning the reads. The share is a WR1's.
WR6 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR2 and a bench RB.
#Skol

Christian McCaffrey, SF RB: a mild hamstring strain at ATL, and he still came back for 13 touches, 100 yards and a TD. Kyle Shanahan is optimistic he is fine after the bye.
RB6 rest of season for me. Trade for him during the bye; offer an RB2 and a WR2.
#FTTB

Chase Brown, CIN RB: 75 percent of the snaps vs BAL and 15 touches to Samaje Perine's 4, but 58 yards and no score while Cincinnati put up 35. Tennessee visits Sunday.
RB7 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer an RB2 and a WR3.
#WhoDey

Tetairoa McMillan, CAR WR: 15 targets over Weeks 6 and 7, then 4 for 40 in a 43-13 loss with Bryce Young pulled. The targets are his whoever throws.
WR14 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR3 and a bench RB.
#KeepPounding

Ashton Jeanty, LV RB: back up to 72 percent of the snaps vs LAR and 8 of 8 targets for 61 and a TD. He ran 8 times for 15 because Las Vegas trailed all day.
RB11 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer an RB2 and a WR3.
#RaiderNation

Brock Purdy, SF QB: a season-high 40 throws at ATL, then a bye.
QB3 for me. Offer a WR2 in superflex, a WR3 in 1-QB leagues.

George Kittle, SF TE: 85 percent of the snaps or more five straight games.
TE3 for me. Offer a WR2.
#FTTB

Patrick Mahomes II, KC QB: no TD pass in two straight games on 63 throws, with Rashee Rice and his right tackle out. The attempts held; the scores did not.
QB9 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR3 in superflex, a bench receiver in 1-QB leagues.
#ChiefsKingdom

Now the sells.

Tony Pollard, TEN RB: 25 carries for 129 and 3 TDs with both backups inactive. He had 14 and 19 carries the two weeks before, and Tennessee is 1-6.
RB30 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for an RB2.
#TitanUp

Javonte Williams, DAL RB: 25 carries for 155 and a TD at PHI, his third straight game with a score, and 0 targets. Five targets in three games is a back living on carries.
RB9 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a top-12 WR.
#DallasCowboys

Tee Higgins, CIN WR: 6 of 7 for 148 and a TD at BAL. Ja'Marr Chase drew 7 too, and both played 46 snaps. That is efficiency, not a bigger share.
WR16 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a WR1, or a WR2 and an RB2.
#WhoDey

Jameson Williams, DET WR: 5 for 91 and 2 TDs on 9 targets vs GB, after 4, 8 and 4 targets in his three games before. Amon-Ra St. Brown drew 11.
WR26 rest of season for me. Trade him away on the two scores; ask for a WR2.
#OnePride

Christian Watson, GB WR: 8 targets in each of his last three games while Matthew Golden drew 13 and 12, and his share fell from 26 percent to 19.
WR17 rest of season for me. Trade him away while his name sells; ask for a WR2.
#GoPackGo

Emanuel Wilson, SEA RB: 24 carries for 100 and a TD vs KC with Zach Charbonnet inactive. Charbonnet is eyed for Sunday vs CHI, and Jadarian Price's practice window opens this week.
RB54 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a bench receiver.
#Seahawks

Woody Marks, HOU RB: 54 of 61 snaps vs NYG and 19 carries for 66. Houston is on bye, and David Montgomery gets two weeks to heal the groin.
RB32 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a bench WR with a full-time role.
#HTownMade

Jaylen Waddle, DEN WR: 4 for 48 at ARI on 56 percent of snaps, then a late chest and shoulder injury. Thursday and Friday practice decide Week 8. Nothing over 48 yards since Week 2.
WR19 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a WR3 who gets targets.
#BroncosCountry

Caleb Douglas, MIA WR: 2 TDs on 3 targets at NYJ.
WR77 for me. Ask for a bench RB with a weekly role.

Malik Willis, MIA QB: 208 yards and 3 total TDs on 21 throws and 8 runs.
QB22 for me. Ask for a WR3 in superflex, a bench RB in 1-QB leagues.
#PhinsUp

Geno Smith, NYJ QB: 3 TD passes vs MIA after 3 in his previous three games.
QB26 for me. Ask for a WR3 in superflex.

Mason Taylor, NYJ TE: 2 TDs on 6 targets, his first scores of the season.
TE37 for me. Ask for a bench WR with a full-time role.
#JetUp

The one trade to make today: Kenneth Walker III, while his manager stares at 36 yards from a game Kansas City never led. Same snaps, same carries share, a softer week ahead at DEN.

Offer an RB2 and a WR3.
#ChiefsKingdom

Every buy and sell with its price is on the site. Follow @FF_ChefHazy for the rest of the week's calls, and repost this for your league.

https://fantasykitchenff.com/butcher.html?week=8
